name: 拍卖（保留价/起拍价）设定

map.🏘️ 拍卖（保留价/起拍价）设定: 🏘️ Setting Auction Reserve and Starting Price
map.按评估价与起拍折扣率设定起拍价、保留价与竞价空间。: Set the starting price, reserve price and bidding headroom from the appraised value and the starting discount rate.
map.📖 查看「拍卖（保留价/起拍价）设定 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Setting Auction Reserve and Starting Price User Guide"
map.💡 起拍价 = 评估价 × 起拍折扣率；保留价按评估价 80% 设定；竞价空间: 💡 Starting price = appraised value × starting discount rate; the reserve price is set at 80% of appraised value; bidding headroom = reserve price − starting price.
map.📚 深度解析：拍卖保留价与起拍价设定: 📚 In-depth: Setting Auction Reserve and Starting Prices
map.法院或债权人设定拍卖保留价。: Courts or creditors set the auction reserve price.
map.按保留价下浮定起拍价。: Set the starting price by discounting off the reserve.
map.评估保留价是否覆盖债权。: Assess whether the reserve covers the debt.
map.评估价 500 万、保留价系数 0.8 → 保留价=500×0.8=400 万；: Appraised value of 5 million yuan at a reserve factor of 0.8 gives a reserve of 500 × 0.8 = 4 million; the starting price is usually discounted further off the reserve (say × 0.7) to about 2.8 million; in cost mode this tool outputs total = A × B.
map.若债权本息 420 万，保留价 400 万则拍卖成交可能不足以覆盖，需下调起拍价: If principal and interest total 4.2 million yuan, a reserve of 4 million may not cover the debt on sale, so lower the starting price to encourage bidding or take additional security.
map.保留价能低于评估价多少？: How far below appraised value can the reserve go?
map.司法拍卖保留价一般不低于评估价 70%–80%，流拍后降价幅度也有法定上限，具体: Judicial auction reserves are generally no lower than 70%-80% of appraised value, and the markdown after a failed auction is also capped by law; follow the applicable rules.
map.起拍价越低越好吗？: Is a lower starting price always better?
map.低起拍吸引竞买但可能贱卖，需在成交率与回收金额间平衡，首次拍卖不宜过低。: A low starting price attracts bidders but risks selling cheap; balance the hit rate against recovery, and do not set it too low for a first auction.
